tagline: Not all hunger comes from your stomach.

landing.heroText: Hungry, or Hungry? helps you tell physical hunger from emotional hunger, gently and without judgement. A small act of awareness, whenever you need it.
landing.f1Text: Four kind questions, before you eat between meals.
landing.f2Text: Ten micro-exercises of 60-120 seconds to ride the wave.
landing.f3Text: Personal reports showing when and why emotional hunger shows up.
landing.priceText: No subscription, no renewals. Pay once and the app is yours forever.
landing.noScales: No calories, no scales. Just listening.

onboarding.s1Text: Physical hunger builds slowly: your stomach rumbles, energy dips, any food will do. Emotional hunger arrives suddenly, asks for something specific and often stays even after eating. Neither is wrong: simply knowing which one you're feeling is already everything.
onboarding.s2Text: Pick the moments when you tend to eat between meals. You can change them anytime.
onboarding.s3Text: Whenever you're about to eat between meals, open the app and press the big button. I'll ask four short questions, one at a time. Then you choose: wait ten minutes, try an exercise, or eat anyway. There is no right answer.

checkin.big: I'm about to eat between meals
checkin.q1: Is this physical hunger (rumbling stomach, low energy) or something else?
checkin.q2: What are you feeling right now?
checkin.q3Placeholder: e.g. an argument with a colleague
checkin.q4: What would you like to do now?
checkin.q4eat: I've decided to eat anyway, and that's fine
checkin.eatMessage: That's okay. What matters is that you're aware of it.
checkin.waitBreath: Breathe in slowly… hold… breathe out. There's nothing else to do.
checkin.waitDone: The ten minutes are up. How do you feel now?
